title: Kitchen and Vow
author: Beatrix Pemberton
blurb: Isandro Coldharbour, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
